responsibility: This file implements GCC’s non-instruction assembly emission and symbol/section management. It is responsible for outputting variables, constants, aliases, constructors/destructors, constant pools, COMDAT/one-only objects, and target sections; creating and caching declaration RTL and symbol refs; selecting data, BSS, TLS, exception, and target-specific sections; merging identical constants where possible; and emitting assembler directives for object definitions and miscellaneous top-level data outside function bodies.
same_name_distinction: Implements the varasm stem’s assembler-output and section-management machinery declared in gcc/varasm.h, including actual emission of variables/constants, section switching, COMDAT handling, declaration RTL creation, and target assembler helpers. Unlike the header, this file maintains the section/output state and performs the real assembly emission work.
